2608.03018.title: UrbanAgent: A Tool-Augmented Agent for Cross-System Urban Tasks
2608.03018.paper_summary: Modern cities rely on an increasing number of digital services to operate, but residents' daily needs are still difficult to meet. Services are fragmented and have little interoperability, placing a heavy operational burden on users. Existing digital platforms, urban foundation models, and intelligent assistants each address only isolated aspects of an urban task. But they struggle to reliably convert complex natural-language requests into executable cross-system workflows. We propose Urban-Agent, a tool-augmented agent framework for cross-system urban tasks. It couples the cognitive and reasoning capabilities of a large language model with a tool-set supporting code execution, API calls, and Model Context Protocol. Through one adaptive closed loop, it clarifies missing information before acting, grounds tool use in live observations, and aligns the final response with observed evidence and task constraints. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce Urban-Eval, a benchmark specifically designed for cross-system urban request. Unlike prior benchmarks that assess either general tool use or urban knowledge and reasoning, Urban-Eval evaluates both task results and execution quality, including required tool coverage, dependency validity, and evidence traceability. Experimental results indicate that Urban-Agent reaches a 71% task success rate, 10 points above the strongest baseline. This lead holds across GPT-5-mini, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-V4-flash, and Qwen3-235B-A22B.
2608.03018.paper_summary_zh: 現代城市依賴越來越多的數位服務來運作，但居民的日常需求仍然難以滿足。服務是碎片化的，且互操作性差，給用戶帶來了沉重的操作負擔。現有的數位平台、城市基礎模型和智能助手各自僅解決城市任務的孤立方面。但它們在可靠地將複雜的自然語言請求轉換為可執行的跨系統工作流程方面面臨困難。我們提出了Urban-Agent，一種增強工具的代理框架，用於跨系統城市任務。它將大型語言模型的認知和推理能力與支持代碼執行、API調用和模型上下文協議的工具集結合在一起。通過一個自適應的閉環，它在行動之前澄清缺失的信息，將工具使用基於實時觀察，並使最終回應與觀察到的證據和任務約束對齊。為了解決評估差距，我們引入了Urban-Eval，一個專門為跨系統城市請求設計的基準。與之前評估一般工具使用或城市知識和推理的基準不同，Urban-Eval同時評估任務結果和執行質量，包括所需的工具覆蓋、依賴有效性和證據可追溯性。實驗結果表明，Urban-Agent達到了71%的任務成功率，比最強基線高出10個點。這一優勢在GPT-5-mini、Gemini-2.5-flash、DeepSeek-V4-flash和Qwen3-235B-A22B中均保持不變。
